subject: Bounded path-sensitive Foundation payload owner checking with fast current-source tests
claim: Eighteen WV case groups pass against the current-source owner-flow component and actual compiler-aligned control phase. They cover all-path initialization, permanent E1 owner freezing, branch joins, backward-edge revisiting, input and work bounds, and rejection of a changed published candidate. Fresh warm execution plus exact cached construction checks takes 2,046 ms. Complete WVB 1.39 admission remains closed.

limitations: Only payload-owner availability and permanent E1 freezing are implemented here. Complete semantic metadata admission, nominal Option/Result relationships, borrowed operand-stack provenance, ordinary direct-call loan lifetimes, non-escape, and runtime execution remain unfinished. All complete consumers still reject minor 39.

The synthetic owner-state streams isolate control flow and deliberately do not establish valid typed operand stacks. The final two groups exercise the actual control phase on the published candidate and an owner-overwrite mutation. They are not complete-module verifier tests.

The component relies on the caller's validated instruction directory and exact five-byte shape cells. It owns explicit bounds of 128 bytecode blocks, 8,192 slots, 1 MiB of code and a module-shared 16,777,216-unit work budget. Ordinary borrow-free functions do not enter this pass.

The existing full memory-budget owner now declares 252 cases, and the combined Foundation selector declares 81. Neither entire selection was rerun here. The earlier publication and 24-case typed-directory evidence remain separate.

The all-changed-file plan selected 24 owners with 5,625 expected seconds and no coverage gaps. It was inspected but not executed under the ten-minute development budget. Broader reconstruction, package, legacy semantic suites, Linux execution, WebAssembly and complete cross-host qualification were not run for this checkpoint.

Timings are single local observations with an existing native bootstrap cache, not clean-host benchmarks, stable speedup thresholds or peak-memory measurements. No process-tree peak working set was captured.
The new WV test fixture uses the current bootstrap source syntax. Its edition-1 source migration remains in the full compiler/library/source migration goal.
